item.title: Rallying Cry – June 18, 2026
item.description: From a giant Messi portrait carved into a Philippine beach to NASA’s selection of Relativity Space for a Mars mission, plus a win for gun rights and a breakthrough in early land vertebrate science, today’s news is full of creativity, progress, and hope.
